state.task: Review the first-deployment sequence for the API and its database.

artifacts.content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 5s
  migrate:
    image: app:local
    command: ["python", "migrate.py"]
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
  api:
    image: app:local
    depends_on:
      migrate: {condition: service_completed_successfully}
migrate.py creates the API tables and exits zero only after committing. The API starts accepting traffic after migration completion.
